## New Features
- Turn on iCloud Sync in Settings on each Mac signed in to the same Apple Account. Overview combines their usage and estimated costs, with a This Mac only switch. iCloud stores summaries, and raw logs stay on each Mac. - New usage is archived in your Mac’s system time zone. Previously archived and imported records keep their dates. - The HUD can hide after 30 seconds without new usage and return when usage arrives. Choose what a triple-click does, and hear a preview when you adjust the volume with sound enabled. - On the Speed tab, search by project, turn name, or turn ID. The list shows six turns per page. - Find Sources, Import, and Manage Backups in Settings. Refresh rates to preview changes to saved estimates before applying them.
## Fixes
- Fill in pending OpenClaw cost estimates when a matching rate is available. - Show the applied long-context rate in MiMo v2 Pro cost details.
